opportunities.title: Small Grants – UK Office (September 2026 deadline)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds; individuals are not accepted unless they can provide organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed‑funding for UK‑Japan collaborative projects across arts, culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine, health, science, youth, education and sport, aiming to deepen mutual understanding and develop lasting collaboration.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards – Medicine and Health (December 2026 deadline)

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record; practitioners, managers, carers or others in health‑related fields are also welcome, especially those early in their career and without prior UK‑Japan collaboration.
opportunities.summary: Awards support exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in the UK and Japan, covering scientific, clinical, social and economic healthcare issues, with funding for travel, conference and publication costs.
